purpose: Source acceptance definitions only; runtime membership, authority, progress and settlement remain in the existing canonical owners.

requirements.name: One retained outcome and complete current instruction
acceptance: Lossless source-turn identity, complete request, restrictions and approved scope survive persistence and recovery; display summaries never become action authority.
Oversized inputs fail explicitly rather than accepting clipped prefixes; fresh requests and corrections supersede only their actual scope.

requirements.name: Actual accepted purpose and history restoration
acceptance: Restore uses accepted HLT history and exact lineage, not a generic draft or a successful-looking no-op.
Unchanged valid purpose does not require another onboarding or root-goal confirmation after ordinary compaction; changed intent still requires its applicable authority.

requirements.name: Exact scope and lifecycle admission without circular recovery
acceptance: Verified project/workstream/attachment, lifecycle, writer, operation and current frontier admit valid work through the existing authority owner.
Missing migration or binding returns a typed supported repair with exact missing facts; foreign, stale or unverified scope never becomes green by suppression.
Read-only independent work is not globally blocked by a write-only dependency; discussion does not manufacture execution authority.

requirements.name: Retained pre-approval is automatically revalidated
acceptance: Existing owner-rooted approval references survive compaction with exact scope, permitted effects, target, consumer, validity, budget and revocation limits.
Recovery revokes blind cached permission but automatically checks still-valid durable grants and continues without a repeated human approval ritual.
A name, tool presence, secret reference, previous successful action, continue message or this authoring file never mints a new grant.

requirements.name: Real transport-backed continuous progression
acceptance: Enabled autonomy proves attached live execution, a current writer and observed progress; queued, registered or HTTP202 is not running.
Every ready authorized dependency stage progresses without a routine continue prompt, including prepare, implement, verify and authorized delivery.
An empty or unreadable queue is not outcome completion; assess remaining in-scope outcome without inventing new scope or work.

requirements.name: Budget and waiting truth
acceptance: Execution, dependency wait, transport absence and resource pressure are distinguished and accounted according to the existing temporal/budget contract; missing transport is not silently billed as successful execution.
Resume uses the existing bounded budget or separately approved renewal; exhausted budgets are never silently reset or extended.
Real budget or consent pauses retain an exact next action and are not mislabeled a flow defect or completed work.

requirements.name: No duplicated replay, dispatch or execution effects
acceptance: Replay preserves original event identity and indexed caller ownership, sequence and checkpoint semantics; no event skipping, synthetic identity or history reset.
Session/run/generation, writer fences and request/effect identities survive restart, delayed responses and duplicate callbacks without duplicate external actions.
Interrupted or uncertain effects are reconciled before retry.

requirements.name: Exact native compaction continuation
acceptance: Actual installed agent/model work crosses at least two successive native compactions and performs the next eligible action after each without an added continue message.
The exact persisted anchor revision/digest/project/session is restored; missing or corrupt requested state never substitutes another generation or request.
Delivery, native reload, agent consumption and a subsequent authorized tool action are separately evidenced; writing a context file alone is not consumption proof.

requirements.name: Discover existing approved access without revealing secrets
acceptance: Point-of-need discovery uses canonical approved secret references and existing authenticated routes, including documented execution user/host; it does not repeatedly assert access is absent without checking the owning route.
Actual broker enforcement binds project, workstream, frame, attempt, operation, target and consumer; advisory credentials_verify is not credential-use authorization.
No ambient inbox, tenant, vault or account access is inferred from a narrower grant.

requirements.name: Protected injection and vault hygiene
acceptance: Approved values are delivered only to exact bound consumers through supported protected channels, not model context, prompts, argv, screenshots, traces or receipts.
Use, reveal, manage, rotate and revoke remain separately authorized; required expiry/use-count/revocation and cross-surface contracts are enforced.
Hardcoded vault login material is removed through its owning adapter and any necessary separately authorized provider rotation; no real secret is copied into this workset or test evidence.

requirements.name: Renewable MFA and truthful restored connectivity
acceptance: Challenge creation and injection are exact provider/target/consumer/window bound, renewable, eligible and one-use; OTP grants never become inbox permission.
Restored encrypted connector proves functional delivery/injection and stable readiness; URL, title or earlier pairing alone cannot pass.
Supported Android/iOS and cross-surface claims require corresponding real-device proof; teardown and encrypted checkpoint recovery are verified.
Recovery codes and finite break-glass assets are excluded from every agent, subprocess, browser and evidence path.

requirements.name: Provider-issued authority renewal and preserved rights
acceptance: Actual provider-supported renewable renewal preserves exact node/account provenance and existing lifetime, customer and developer rights without fabricating local authority.
Existing valid grants do not prompt redundant customer activation; real consent/issuer/account requirements remain explicit.
Outage, malformed response, expiry, entitlement denial and local transport failure have distinct typed recovery; no local key/lease/entitlement override passes.

requirements.name: Effective capability use and bounded context
acceptance: The agent discovers the narrowest suitable available capability, follows its actual schema, scope, permissions and health, and uses independent appropriate capabilities while a dependency waits.
Registration does not imply execution readiness; missing introspection is not stale-contract proof.
All applicable capabilities remain discoverable, but loading or using every tool indiscriminately is not a success metric; minimal sufficient context and consumer evidence are preferred.

requirements.name: Typed recovery without false blockers or bypass
acceptance: A blocker identifies the exact affected operation, authoritative cause, current evidence, safe retry/repair, independent ready work and the precise human action only when irreducible.
Retry/repair is bounded and effect-aware; circular resume/checkpoint loops, generic process-ceremony stops and optional reporting dependency deadlocks fail acceptance.
Real safety, legality, scope, auth, consent, explicit stop, required quality and exhausted-budget boundaries remain enforced; no global green or bypass is fabricated.

requirements.name: Resource and durable-state safety
acceptance: Applicable quota/disk/memory/CPU pressure and durable-write failure are visible before misleading healthy/running claims, using existing resource owners.
KH control plane and OVH heavy execution remain separated; cleanup touches only verified rebuildable owned artifacts under its actual grant.
Recoverability and accepted history survive failure; event/database reset, unknown deletion, demo disruption or foreign-target cleanup cannot be a remedy.

requirements.name: Coherent documentation, skills and native plugin consumption
acceptance: Existing canonical guides, deep runbooks, generated mirrors, tool contracts and Pi guidance agree with installed behavior and required recovery paths.
Changed guidance is natively reloaded and actual agent consumption is evidenced, not assumed from file presence or a command in another process.
Existing maintenance triggers cover relevant behavior/SDK changes, pre-release and between-release reviews without a new inventory, policy store, scheduler or paid automation.

requirements.name: Correction and legitimate pause continuity
acceptance: Natural-language correction changes only its stated scope; an explicit whole-mission stop halts immediately and safely fences queued work.
Required human consent, unresolved ownership, unavailable nonrenewable-safe access and exhausted budgets pause the affected operation with durable exact continuation.
After the condition is legitimately resolved, revalidation resumes eligible work without losing purpose or repeating unrelated onboarding.

requirements.name: Verified progress, installed delivery and whole-issue closure
acceptance: Every required requirement is met by versioned contract, actual producer/consumer tests, claimed cross-version interoperability and installed end-to-end proof before canonical workset settlement.
Exact candidate CI, full signed stable matrix, public release, trusted installation, configuration, native reload and consumer-visible acceptance are separate evidenced stages.

Issue closure covers the entire issue's acceptance, not just this flow slice; #299/#526 and #261 remain open if any approved scope is unmet. Related programs #101/#252/#253 are not automatically closed.

Measured outcomes distinguish real progress from queued work, waiting, model turn endings and mission completion; no fabricated timing, benchmark, lesson, credential-use grant or successful run is accepted.
